case_name: Khushboo Khanna Alias Gudia vs Punjab State Power Corporation Ltd

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Khushboo Khanna Alias Gudia and another (minor children)
parties.respondent_defendant: Punjab State Power Corporation Limited and others

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioners are minor children seeking family pension on account of death of their father. Respondents rejected the claim without considering relevant factors.

legal_principles.principle: This court cannot decide a disputed question of facts while exercising its powers under Article 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India.
legal_principles.held: A two-Judge Bench of the Hon'ble Apex Court in Orissa Agro Industries Corporation Ltd. Vs. Bharati Industries (2005) 12 SCC 725, observed that as follows: '9. A bare perusal of the High Court's judgment shows that there was clear non-application of mind.'
cited_cases: Orissa Agro Industries Corporation Ltd. Vs. Bharati Industries (2005) 12 SCC 725

legal_principles.principle: A court cannot decide a disputed question of facts in a writ petition.
legal_principles.held: The High Court should have dismissed the case after coming to the above conclusions.
cited_cases: Orissa Agro Industries Corporation Ltd. Vs. Bharati Industries (2005) 12 SCC 725

outcome.final_order: The petition was dismissed, and respondents were directed not to release family pension in favour of respondent No.4.
